english: I don't know anyone who did that luckily. I think it's really sad. I mean, you know, I don't think it's really that common.
chinese: 我不知道有谁幸运地这样做了。我觉得真的很悲哀。你知道的，我不认为这很常见。

english: Now, but there was a movie just about this. So there's a woman, Julia Roberts, who tries and tries and tries to get married but never can.
chinese: 现在，但其实有一部电影就是讲这件事的。所以有一个女人，朱丽娅·罗伯茨，她努力地去结婚，但却一直没能成功。

english: So it's called Run Away Bride. Because every time she goes to the altar, she gets nervous. She gets cold feet and she runs away.
chinese: 所以叫《逃出婚礼》。因为她每次都要走到教堂，她就会紧张得脚软，然后就跑了。

english: Alright, so they call her the Run Away Bride. I can't imagine this actually happening to someone. I mean, you have all your family there, your friends.
chinese: 好吧，他们叫她“逃婚新娘”。我真想象不到这真的会发生。你身边还有你的家人，你的朋友。

english: You know, be so embarrassing. It's amazing. And expensive. Exactly. Because you've already paid for everything.
chinese: 你知道，真是丢人。真是太棒了。又太贵了。正是如此。因为你已经付过钱了。

english: So do you get to eat the cake if you're the one who's left behind? I don't, I think so. Everything's paid for, right?
chinese: 那么你被留下时能吃蛋糕吗？我觉得不能，一切都已经付好了。

english: Exactly. And drink all the liquor. Alright. So that's all the time we have for today. If you have any questions, any comments you can come to our website at EnglishPod.com. And we'll see you guys there.
chinese: 明白了。再喝一杯酒吧。好的。这就是我们今天的时间了。如果有任何问题或评论，你们可以访问我们的网站 EnglishPod.com。我们会在那里见到你们。

english: Bye everyone. Bye.
chinese: 再见 everyone。再见。

english: Bye.
chinese: 再见。
